journey.name: Contact Request Or Pay On A Compact Screen
journey.description: Verifies that the Request or Pay sheet keeps its Pay and Request actions on screen on a compact display and with enlarged text: the illustration shrinks first, then the headline and description scroll, while the action row stays pinned above the bottom edge. Uses the same two linked Bitkit instances as contact-request-or-pay.xml; see README.md. Make the display 320 x 640 dp with `adb shell wm size 960x1920` and `adb shell wm density 480`, and enlarge text with `adb shell settings put system font_scale 2.0`; restore with `adb shell wm size reset`, `adb shell wm density reset` and `adb shell settings put system font_scale 1.0`. Open the contact with adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "bitkit://contact?pubky=<requester-public-key>" to.bitkit.dev.

actions.action: Run `adb shell wm size 960x1920` and `adb shell wm density 480`
Open bitkit://contact?pubky=<requester-public-key> on the payer and tap Pay (testTag "ContactPay")

Verify the Request or Pay sheet (testTag "RequestOrPaySheet") shows the Pay (testTag "RequestOrPayPay") and Request (testTag "RequestOrPayRequest") buttons side by side, both fully inside the screen bounds
Close the sheet and run `adb shell settings put system font_scale 2.0`

Verify Pay (testTag "RequestOrPayPay") and Request (testTag "RequestOrPayRequest") are stacked, both fully inside the screen bounds, and the headline and description can be scrolled to their last line without moving the buttons
Tap Pay on the sheet and verify its button shows a loading spinner and Request is disabled until the send amount screen opens; close it without paying
Tap Pay (testTag "ContactPay"), tap Request (testTag "RequestOrPayRequest") and verify the Payment Request amount screen (testTag "PaymentRequestAmount") opens; go back
Run `adb shell settings put system font_scale 1.0`, `adb shell wm size reset` and `adb shell wm density reset`
